_comment: Settings for the triage session. WARNING: this is NOT a security boundary, only a hint: measured 2026-07-29, a command outside the allow list still runs, and a Bash deny rule also disables the needed probe. The real boundary is a separate unprivileged user and a read-only filesystem (see the systemd unit). This lists what the analysis clearly does not need, so the model does not waste turns on it.
